title.rendered: Joby John, Founder & CEO of Techversant | Indian Industry Delegation, Canada | May 2026

content.rendered:
oby John, Founder and CEO of Techversant was privileged & proud to be part of the Indian Industry Delegation to Canada at the Western Canada-India Leader’s Summit, Sasketchewan, Canada during May 2026. The delegation was led by the Hon’ble Union Minister of Commerce & Industry Shri Piyush Goyal, India and represented by the Hon’ble Minister of International Trade Mr. Maninder Sidhu, Canada.
The renewed momentum in India-Canada economic engagement reflects the strength of this important partnership and look forward to the successful conclusion of the India-Canada Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA). This would create new opportunities for trade, investment, innovation and collaboration between the two nations.

title.rendered: Joby John, Founder & CEO of Techversant at the India-Canada CEO Forum | New Delhi | 2 March 2026

content.rendered:
It was a moment of immense pride for Techversant as its Founder & CEO, Joby John, was nominated to participate in the India–Canada CEO Forum held in New Delhi on 2 March 2026, under the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India.

It was a distinguished honour for Joby to meet and interact with the Honourable Prime Minister of India Shri Narendra Modi and the Honourable Prime Minister of Canada Mark Carney.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi along with the Prime Minister Mark Carney addressed the India-Canada CEO Forum, which comprised of leading businesspersons from both countries. PM noted that India and Canada together represent a substantive economic force, combining capital and capability. PM highlighted key areas for joint economic cooperation, including clean energy, civil nuclear partnership, critical minerals, infrastructure and capital, manufacturing and technology-particularly AI-as well as food processing and other emerging sectors.
The Forum explored avenues to deepen economic and commercial ties – with a focus on enhancing trade, investment, innovation and people-to-people linkages between India and Canada.

With Techversant’s strong and growing client base in Canada, participation in this prestigious Forum further reinforces the Company’s commitment to building meaningful cross-border partnerships and contributing to a stronger India–Canada business corridor.

title.rendered: Techversant hosts the team from Bavarian State Ministry – Feb 2026

content.rendered:
Techversant was privileged to host Mr. Benjamin Riedel, Member of the Bavarian State Ministry for Economic Affairs, & Mr. John Kottayil, Executive Director, State of Bavaria India Office, at our Technopark Trivandrum Office.
The Bavarian delegates were received by Techversant’s Founder and CEO Mr. Joby John along with Mr. Manoj Madhavan, VP – HR. This was followed by a detailed business discussion with Joby John, focusing on collaboration, opportunities, and innovation.
